ModMetaData.name: IsoRim Waylith - Combat Extended Pack
ModMetaData.author: Lin
ModMetaData.description:
Combat Extended in IsoRim's 3D view.
- Bullets, shells and grenades fly at Combat Extended's real height, from the muzzle - Mortar shells drawn on their real arc, like IsoRim's own shells - Works on IsoRimZ floors
让 Combat Extended 在 IsoRim 的 3D 视角中正常显示。
- 子弹、炮弹和手雷按 Combat Extended 的真实高度从枪口飞出 - 迫击炮弹沿真实弹道显示，与 IsoRim 自己的炮弹一致 - 支持 IsoRimZ 的楼层
